answer: Random Assignment Audit Pool. Each agent gets a periodic audit slot via a public randomness beacon; the beacon's later-revealed seed picks which anonymous agents must expose a fresh hardware attestation. The voyage of a sybil from slot to slot is unpredictable, so flood strategies cannot pre-position witnesses. An attacker must supply a unique attested device per identity at each zenith of the challenge cycle. Failed audits emit a public signal excluding the identity from payouts, and replacement cost is one physical device plus attestation per slot.
